targets.title: Gratitude and prosocial behavior: Helping when it costs you.
targets.evidence_quote:
Specifically, we attempted to replicate and extend Bartlett and DeSteno’s (2006)

Study 1 by additionally including a measure of indebtedness.
targets.outcome_quote:
Surprisingly, the replication was

not successful. We did not find support for the idea that receiving help promoted reciprocal

behavior, and neither gratitude nor indebtedness was associated with reciprocal behavior.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly describe the replication as unsuccessful; the manipulation succeeded but neither main nor mediation effects replicated.

reasoning: An extended replication in a new Dutch student sample of Bartlett and DeSteno Study 1. Citation author initials are copied as printed in this manuscript, including Bartlett L.
